title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity

reports.title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity

summary:
A person in the Ards and north Down area of Northern Ireland lost £250,000 after an AI-generated scam. Police said the victim saw an AI-made video that appeared to feature a well-known person from the financial sector. It advertised an investment opportunity and promised large returns. After a small initial investment, the victim was contacted on WhatsApp and urged to pay more. The fraudsters had the victim open several online accounts and gained remote access to their computer, saying they were helping with the investment.

PSNI called it a complex and serious fraud. It said the criminals built trust and pushed the victim to borrow money, then moved funds to accounts they controlled. Police did not name the celebrity. BBC News NI said it has seen similar scams using financial experts Martin Lewis, Peter Jones and Steven Bartlett. Superintendent Joanne Gibson of the Scamwise Partnership urged people to stop and check financial activity and to talk with relatives about fraud. Police advised verifying who you are dealing with and checking that financial services are authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority.
